children: Beijing's broadest policy package yet attempts to tackle a six-year housing slump that has left 4 mln homes unsold. Spanning everything from presale financing to mortgage repayments, the reforms aim to reduce supply and rebuild confidence, not to boost immediate demand.
Full view will be published shortly.
China's property sales by floor area declined 12.1% year-on-year in the first eight months of 2026, official data released on September 15 showed.

A total of 10 ministries and regulators on August 28 announced coordinated reforms on regulating China’s real estate market. The package includes measures to tighten presale requirements, extends mortgage and development-loan tenors and increases project funding supervision.
